dimensions.overworld: PS4 port / target Java feature integration

native_harness: Bounded original CPU routines with controlled world/block/biome bindings, no module startup or game entry point. Reproduction tools are in docs/reference-tools/ps4. Original executables, platform SDKs and analysis projects are excluded.
adaptations: Native Java1.17.1 storage/block/entity APIs and loot/mob spawning
Procedural structure block-placement expressions/helpers adapted to recovered PS4 rules; full final-block equality not proven
Twelve non-template village decoration features use target-version configured-feature/block adapters
Native finite collision border, mod-only wall draw cancellation, optional client PS4 biome profile; unmodded clients keep their own wall/tint renderer
Shipwreck terrain samples use the actual rotated 1.17.1 template footprint to avoid hovering over water when a neighbouring preview chunk is elevated.

Legacy population now uses the translated PS4 dispatcher and feature kernels through a Java world adapter; modern additions run afterward with separate streams. Full original world physics, structure/RNG and whole-world parity remain unverified.
not_claimed: Complete PS4 seed-to-block equality, native PS4 save compatibility, console platform emulation.
